additional_info.subject: Ticket Creation Request - Black Screen on Sitrans Charging Station
additional_info.body:
Hello,
I would like to report an incident concerning the client Sitrans, Mr. Grisval, who contacted me this morning at 9:05 AM at +33 6 16 01 27 11. He informed me that the screen of the SiD is black.
Incident details:
•     Charging station serial number: Y2/S2 313518164001
•     Restart attempt was unsuccessful as the station is offline on the backend.
It is therefore important to create a ticket and initiate the necessary corrective actions to resolve this issue. A black screen gives the impression that the station is not working, which confuses drivers.
According to Sébastien, despite the black screen, a charging session was started.
Thank you for addressing this issue promptly.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|
+33 970 755 400
